title: Enhanced Combat Page View
description: Port of Cyaminthe's Enhanced Combat Page View (Workshop 2802216129) as a host callback on an observation gate: the combat pages in the hand are zoomed (x1.25, 25% bigger, by default), and in Touchscreen Mode a tap on another page swaps the selected page, playing an On-Play page keeps the speed die selected, and holding an On-Play page that only affects its user for 0.75 seconds (the left button on it, or X on the selected page) plays it without a target, and while a page is selected the character info panels can be faded to 75% transparent and made click-through. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Enhanced Combat Page View
launcher.note: Gives you the ability to Zoom-in combat pages on your hand, along with other fixes. Original mod by [Cyaminthe’s Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2802216129)

settings.label: Page zoom
settings.note: How much bigger the combat pages in your hand are. x1.25 is 25% bigger.

settings.label: Page Swapping
settings.note: Swap selected pages without having to unselect your current page (only available in touchscreen mode)

settings.label: Suppress On-Play deselect
settings.note: Using an 'On-Play' combat page no longer exits you out of the deck

settings.label: Hold to On-Play
settings.note: Holding an 'On-Play' combat page automatically plays it without having to target an enemy

settings.label: Fade info panels
settings.note: While a combat page is selected, the character info panels become 75% transparent and click-through, and return to normal once no page is selected

obs._comment: main build ID -> rows {gate, offset, word, reason}; offsets are RVAs of dump.cs (main = RVA + 0x234000 in the DmIOS file).

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: BattleUnitCardsInHandUI.Update entry (once a frame): x0 = the hand; _cardList at 0x18

BattleDiceCardUI.OnPdSubmit entry + 4 (after touch-ui's hover gate at +0): x0 = the pressed combat page, x1 = the event data; GetClickableState refuses a page while the hand holds a selected one, because ShowDetail leaves _bEntered clear
BattleUnitCardsInHandUI.ApplySelectedCard entry: x0 = the hand; _selectedCard at 0x60 and _beforeSelectDice (the speed die the hand was opened from) at 0xA0 are still set

SpeedDiceUI.OnClickSpeedDice, after the ReleaseSelectedCard call that follows ApplySelectedCard (one instruction later than the call's return, because the instruction right after the call is an adrp, which an observation gate cannot relocate): the hand is closed and the selected ally die is cleared, so a click on the remembered die selects it again

BattleUnitInformationUI.Update, the instruction after its CanvasGroup.set_alpha call (_canvasGroup at 0xD0): x19 = the panel, and the alpha the game just wrote is still readable, so a callback here can scale it; the game writes it again next frame, which is how the fade reverts

BattleDiceCardUI.OnPdSubmit, the instruction after its GetClickableState call: x19 = the pressed page, w0 = the state; 2, 3 and 4 make OnPdSubmit call PlayVibeCard (the shake and its sound), 1 calls OnClick, and 0 makes it return, which is what a tap on the selected page that swap_press already handled gets
